jobs.title: Environmental Characterization/Remediation Geologist/Hydrogeologist
jobs.description:
Location
  
Irvine, California, United States
  
  

Capabilities
  
Environmental
  
  

Office Setup
  
Hybrid
  
  

Job ID
  
\#41681
  
Market
  
Environmental
  
  

At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission\-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting\-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  

Your impact
  
  

We’re seeking an environmental geologist/hydrogeologist with a background in environmental site characterization and remediation to support the delivery of challenging projects for government and global private sector clients.
  
  

Based out of the California area, you’ll work with other scientists, engineers, subject matter experts, and project managers on exciting projects in which you will learn from others and pass along your knowledge. Responsibilities may include designing, performing, or overseeing soil, soil vapor, groundwater, and surface water investigations, working among teams of colleagues and subcontractors, coordinating and managing fieldwork logistics, data analysis and interpretation, and technical report writing. You'll work alongside recognized technical experts, developing and implementing comprehensive site strategies, and delivering innovative solutions for some of our most challenging site issues.
  
  

Projects require thoughtful strategy development, leveraging technical expertise, and collaboration with clients and stakeholders. All projects must be delivered with the high safety, compliance, and quality standards expected by both Jacobs and our client. Our global team is here to provide you with the tools and support needed to grow your skills and career, as well as those of your colleagues. By driving consistency and innovation across projects, you'll help your team achieve client goals. Bring your positive attitude and strong, collaborative style, and together, we'll tackle complex environmental remediation challenges and solve our client’s problems.
  
  

At Jacobs, we’re partnering across the globe to create the best project outcomes by maximizing the design, digital technology, and support capabilities of our Global Integrated Delivery (GID) teammates. By joining Jacobs, you’ll commit to supporting and engaging with these teams, as we work to build a company like no other.
  
  

Here's what you'll need
  
  

Bachelor's degree in geology or other closely related field.
  
At least 3 years of experience delivering environmental site characterization and remediation projects, including fieldwork methodology/procedures and assessment/evaluation of data for various environmental media (e.g., soil, sediments, groundwater)
  
Experience conducting environmental remediation site investigation field work, working on project sites, and overseeing subcontractors.
  
Experience working with multi\-disciplinary teams toward a common goal.
  
40\-hr HAZWOPER certification or the ability to attain this certification.
  
Effective verbal and written communication skills with coworkers and contractors.
  
Strong attention to detail when conducting field work and evaluating data.
  
  

\#LI\-AC4
  
  

**Posted Salary Range:** Minimum
  
70,900\.00
  
  

**Posted Salary Range:** Upper
  
107,250\.00
  
  

Our health and welfare benefits are designed to invest in you, and in the things you care about. Your health. Your well\-being. Your security. Your future. Employees have access to medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance, a 401(k) plan, and the ability to purchase company stock at a discount. Eligible employees may also enroll in a deferred compensation plan or the Executive Deferral Plan. Jacobs has an unlimited U.S. Personalized Paid Time Off (PPTO) policy for full\-time salaried/exempt employees, seven paid holidays, and caregiver leave. And certain roles may be eligible for additional rewards, including merit increases, performance discretionary bonus, and stock.
  
  

The base salary range for this position is $70,900\.00 to $107,250\.00\. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. Job posted on July 02, 2026\. This position will be open for at least 3 days.
  
  

We value collaboration and believe that in\-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
  
  

Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support .

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Geologist
jobs.description:
Discover your full potential. At Tetra Tech, we are collaborating with industry\-leading experts for a sustainable future for our world. We combine consulting and engineering with advanced analytics and technology to solve the world’s most complex challenges. Our innovation hubs across the globe will enable you to share ideas and best practices while growing your professional network. Wherever you are in your career journey, you will benefit from working with world\-class engineers, scientists, and technical specialists.

  

At Tetra Tech, we are Leading with Science to solve the world’s most complex challenges. Our industry\-leading experts in engineering and consulting are committed to driving positive change in communities around the world. For over 50 years, we have been at the forefront of innovation and sustainability. Today we stand as a market leader, offering cutting\-edge solutions in water, environment, energy, and international development. Our work has improved more than 625 million lives around the world.

  

Join Tetra Tech to make a real difference. Our work leverages cutting\-edge technologies, advanced analytics, and the expertise of world\-class scientists and engineers to create meaningful change around the world. Discover your full potential – join us to advance your career while leaving a lasting legacy.

  

Apply today and join the company that is Leading with Science®.

  

Tetra Tech is adding an Engineering Geologist to our team based in Diamond Bar, CA. The group specializes in geotechnical engineering and geologic assessment projects mostly locally in southern California and also regularly in the Southwest United States and occasionally internationally. Our projects include dams and levees, mines, landfills, brownfield redevelopments, infrastructure projects as well as conventional geotechnical engineering projects, and forensic services and peer review services. Our clients are well diversified between state and local agencies (cities and counties), federal agencies (USACE, FEMA, FERC) as well as nationwide private and public clients. The pay scale for this position is $130,000 to $170,000 annually based on qualifications and experience.


You will have the opportunity to grow your technical and business skills and contribute to some of the most complex engineering projects. We offer comprehensive benefits, competitive salary and an entrepreneurial career path that values innovation and excellence.


The selected candidate should have at least 15 years of direct professional experience in geotechnical consulting. You should be proficient in advanced geotechnical field work, geological analyses, and project management tasks. We are a collaborative team comprised of geotechnical engineers, engineering geologists, advanced degree professionals, as well as field staff and consultants frequently working on multi\-disciplinary projects across several operating units at Tetra Tech.

**Your Role**:

* Perform and/or manage geotechnical field investigations, fault studies, site inspections, and construction observations and testing
* Perform analyses of collected field data, laboratory data and published data for the purpose of developing appropriate geotechnical design recommendations suitable for civil/structural design, permitting, certification and assessment.
* Perform geologic evaluation tasks, including geologic maps and cross\-sections, borehole and trench logs, and written descriptions of geologic conditions
* Perform geologic hazard evaluations with focus on fault studies, landsliding
* Prepare and/or assist in the preparation of design reports
* Provide mentorship to junior staff

 **Qualifications**:

* Bachelor's or master’s degree in geology and at least 15 years of direct relevant professional experience
* PG and CEG, or the ability to sit for a CEG exam
* Proficiency in geologic field logging of borings, test pits, and trenches
* Proficiency in geologic field mapping
* Management of field and office staff
* Analyses of engineering geological data
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite. Some competency in illustration software is also desirable, e.g., Autocad, Adobe Illustrator, CorelDraw, ArcGIS
* Preparation of proposals and reports
* Self\-starter, analytical, and possess excellent computer, writing, and oral communication skills
* Experience in field investigation and construction quality assurance activities
* Some travel (up to approximately 20% \- 25%) should be anticipated
* The applicant must be able to work outdoors under varying weather conditions, travel by foot over rough terrain, and lift at least 40 pounds


**Life at Tetra Tech:**  

The perks of working at Tetra Tech include:

* Comprehensive and market\-competitive benefits.
* Merit\-based financial rewards.
* Flexibility and company\-wide commitment to work/life balance.
* Collaborative team atmosphere that values the contributions of all employees.
* Learning and development opportunities for ongoing professional growth.

 **About Tetra Tech:**  

Tetra Tech is the leader in water, environment, and sustainable infrastructure, providing high\-end consulting and engineering services for projects worldwide. With 25,000 employees working together, Tetra Tech provides clear solutions to complex problems by Leading with Science® to address the entire water cycle, protect and restore the environment, design sustainable and resilient infrastructure, and support the clean energy transition.

 **Tetra Tech** is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified candidates will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by law. Tetra Tech is a VEVRAA federal contractor and we request priority referral of veterans.

  

We invite applications from all interested parties.

  

Explore our open positions at https://www.tetratech.com/caree

jobs.title: Environmental Scientist/Fish Biologist
jobs.description:
Environmental Scientist/Fish Biologist

**Introduction:**

Point Environmental LLC is a small consulting firm based in Oregon City which helps its clients maintain compliance with environmental regulations in the construction and resource management industries throughout Oregon and Washington. The company is looking for a full\-time **Environmental Scientist/Fish Biologist** (Bio) to serve primarily in our southern service area. The southern service area extends from Oregon City to Eugene, and the company would prefer to hire an individual who currently resides between Oregon City and Salem.

The Bio will be assigned equipment, a company vehicle, and will be expected to report to jobsites or the Oregon City office directly from their residence the majority of the time. Therefore, their residence should be in the southern service area but within comfortable commuting distance of the Oregon City office at 914 Molalla Ave, Oregon City, OR 97045\.

The Bio’s primary responsibilities will involve providing environmental permit compliance and construction site erosion and sediment control inspection. The Bio’s other duties will include various environmental compliance tasks, particularly assisting with fish rescue/salvage operations during the summer in\-water work period, ESA species compliance, CWA compliance, and NEPA compliance.

The Bio is expected to work normal hours from 8am to 5pm Monday through Friday, but within that time, will be largely managing their own schedule which varies depending on weather conditions and project activities. Therefore, the individual needs to be self\-motivated and highly dependable.

**Responsibilities include:**

· Travel to multiple sites in Oregon, Washington, and occasionally Idaho

· Construction site inspection

· Fish salvage

· Remote stream survey

· Log entries using written and digital formats

· Thorough photo documentation

· Record keeping

· Report writing

· Communication with superintendents, foreman, and clients

· Spending long periods of time on your feet walking in inclement weather and rough terrain

**Job Requirements:**

· Bachelor's degree in fish biology, environmental science, or similar field

· At least **one (1\) of the** following Oregon DEQ acceptable erosion and sediment control inspection certifications:

o Certified Professional in Erosion and Sediment Control (CPESC)

o Certified Professional in Storm Water Quality (CPSWQ)

o Certified Erosion and Sediment Control Lead (CESCL)

o Rogue Valley Sewer Services Erosion and Sediment Control Certification

· Minimum 1 year experience (Please Include a List of Projects)

· Valid driver’s license

· Need to provide own weather appropriate clothing including above the ankle leather work boots. Point Environmental will provide the necessary safety PPE.

· Must currently have reliable transportation.

· A motivated and organized individual with honesty, integrity, who wants to work, and who is willing to learn and share their individuality and ideas to better the company.

· Construction casual attire and appearance, e.g. jeans or kakis with collard shirt or Point Environmental T\-shirt.

· Experience with Microsoft Office Suite and Adobe Acrobat Pro

**Job Preferences:**

· Preference will be given to those individuals with an educational emphasis and additional work experience in fish biology, electrofishing, forestry, civil construction, QGIS, etc.

**Compensation:**

The Bio will be an “at will” employee who will receive an hourly compensation commensurate with experience.

**Hiring Schedule:**

Immediately. Interviews will be scheduled with acceptable candidates.

**Benefits:**

Health/Dental insurance is available for employees working 30 hours a week or more.

Paid time off

Remote work

Company vehicle or paid mileage

Career training

Self\-management, flexible

Small company, relaxed atmosphere

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $25\.00 \- $30\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person
